critical_finding.consequence: The base semantic class can be reconstructed exactly from nuisance structure without reading the SITUATION/OBSERVATION/STATE/CASE content. The target slot then follows from the visible episode-local mapping. Therefore a model can minimize training loss without learning the intended content-dependent semantic-to-codebook binding operation.
critical_finding.why_current_validator_misses_it: The validator requires at least three global codebook orders and zero global class-symbol mutual information, but it does not test conditional independence of display order from semantic class given mapping and template. Global balance can coexist with a perfect higher-order shortcut.
critical_finding.relation_to_v1_audit: The v1 swarm audit required counterfactual display-order coverage inside each fixed semantic/mapping cell. v2 does not implement that stronger condition; it only changes the deterministic order schedule.

adversarial_reviewer_proof_obligation.required_counterfactual_cell: For each fixed semantic scenario, S3 mapping, template and query polarity, vary codebook display order independently while preserving the same target.
adversarial_reviewer_proof_obligation.minimum_strong_design: Cross each positive semantic/mapping/template cell with all six display orders, or use a preregistered orthogonal array whose conditional contingency tables prove zero information leakage.
validator_requirements: For every fixed (scenario_id, mapping_id, template_id, query_polarity), require complete or preregistered-balanced display-order support.
Compute conditional mutual information I(semantic_class; display_order | mapping_id, template_id, query_polarity); require exactly zero for the exact factorial design.
Add a nuisance-only decoder test using mapping/template/order metadata; reject the dataset if nuisance-only accuracy exceeds chance beyond a preregistered tolerance.
Add counterfactual pairs where only display order changes and target remains identical.
Add counterfactual pairs where only the S3 mapping changes and target changes exactly according to the new mapping.
Keep frozen unseen-template and unseen-real-ABI-symbol holdouts outside checkpoint/mixture/threshold selection.

next_exact_action: Create or retain one Trigger-2 v3 factorial generator that independently crosses semantic scenario, all six S3 mappings, all six codebook display orders, query polarity and template family; add a nuisance-only decoder/conditional-MI gate; then materialize exact verified ABI atoms and run split-isolation/family/provenance validators before any training admission.
